description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to internationalization (i18n) translations within an admin plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class, encapsulating fields such as language ID, source and translated text, group ID, and a flag for only showing translated entries.

classes.name: I18NTranslationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class that encapsulates filtering criteria for searching internationalization translation entries, including language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and a flag to filter only translated entries.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Returns the language ID used in the search filter.

methods.name: setLanguageId
methods.description: Sets the language ID used in the search filter.

methods.name: getSourceText
methods.description: Returns the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: setSourceText
methods.description: Sets the source text filter criterion.

methods.name: getTranslatedText
methods.description: Returns the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: setTranslatedText
methods.description: Sets the translated text filter criterion.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Returns the group ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setGroupId
methods.description: Sets the group ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Returns whether the filter should include only translated entries.

methods.name: setOnlyTranslated
methods.description: Sets whether the filter should include only translated entries.
